correctness.rationale: For odd p and k≥2, primitive square-zero 2×2 matrices over R=Z/p^k form the GL2(R) orbit of E12, parametrized by a projective line and a unit, giving degree (p²−1)p^{2k−2}. Trace pairing against a frequency produces a primitive binary quadratic form q_A=cx²+(d−a)xy−by². Unit Ramanujan sums reduce the Fourier eigenvalue to p^k(Z_k−Z_{k−1}) for projective roots. After dividing content p^t, quadratic discriminant and Hensel square-root lifting give all even/odd m=k−t eigenvalue strata. Smooth lifting of the discriminant among primitive forms with zero reduced discriminant gives uniform H_m=(p²−1)p^{2m−2} multiplicity, and p^k free scalar frequency shifts yield exact spectrum/rank. In particular rank p^7 at k=2 and asymptotic nonzero fraction Θ_p(p^{−k}). Independent exact projective character-Ramanujan checks for all 729 primitive quadratic coefficient triples at p=3,k=2 gave no discrepancies and the zero/nonzero histogram agrees after multiplying scalar-frequency multiplicity.

value.rationale: The complete arithmetic spectral multiset of a canonical primitive nilpotent conjugacy class over all odd finite local chain rings is a natural Cayley-graph invariant. The exact p-adic valuation parity strata and exponentially sparse supported frequencies at growing depth are structural phenomena, not a routine restatement of finite-field bounds.

limitations: Only p odd, k≥2, primitive regular square-zero orbit on 2×2 matrices.
All-depth algebraic proof does not equate to exhaustive direct Fourier-sum computation beyond tested small cases.
